title: Settings
backupDescription: Create automatic database snapshots and export the full database workspace.
backupEnabledDescription: Periodically save a SQLite snapshot beside the main database while Memorilo is running.
backupIntervalDescription: Create a new snapshot after this many minutes.
backupRetentionDescription: Remove older automatic snapshots after this limit is reached.
databaseRestoreRestarting: Database prepared. Memorilo will restart to finish restoring it.
deviceDescription: Configure your e-paper device over Bluetooth or USB serial.
deviceSetupSummary: Open Bluetooth configuration mode, or connect the device over USB.
devicePairingProvidePin: Enter the six-digit code shown on the device.
devicePairingConfirmPin: Confirm that this code matches the code shown on the device.
devicePairingConfirm: Confirm the pairing request on both devices.
deviceNameDescription: The name shown in Memorilo and Bluetooth menus.
deviceWifiSsidDescription: Network name saved on the device.
deviceWifiNetworksDescription: Scan from the device. You can still type a hidden network above.
deviceWifiPasswordDescription: Leave empty to keep Wi-Fi without a password.
deviceWifiPasswordSavedDescription: A password is already saved. Leave empty to keep it unchanged.
deviceClearWifiPasswordDescription: Remove the stored password when applying these settings.
deviceLocalManagementNotConfigured: No access token is configured on the device.
deviceLocalManagementStored: The device is protected and Memorilo has the encrypted credential for local access.
deviceLocalManagementMissing: The device has a token, but this Memorilo installation does not. Rotate it to restore access.
deviceLocalManagementPendingReplace: A new write-only token will be installed and saved with operating-system encryption when you apply.
deviceLocalManagementPendingClear: The device token and Memorilo's encrypted copy will be removed when you apply.
deviceTimezoneDescription: Use an IANA time zone such as Asia/Shanghai.
deviceWeatherDescription: Optional hourly weather cache; enter a display name and coordinates.
deviceAlmanacDescription: User-supplied note only; it is not authoritative advice.
deviceTodoSyncDescription: Read-only TODO snapshots can arrive from the server or from Memorilo over the local network.
deviceTodoSyncLanAddressDescription: Private IPv4 address and optional port of this device. Leave empty to disable desktop LAN pushes.
deviceTodoSyncLanStatusIdle: Configured; waiting for a local TODO change.
deviceTodoSyncLanStatusPending: A local TODO update is queued.
deviceTodoSyncLanStatusSuccess: The latest local TODO update was delivered.
deviceTodoSyncLanStatusError: The latest local TODO update failed: {{error}}
deviceTodoSyncUrlDescription: Base URL for the server snapshot endpoint. HTTPS is required.
deviceTodoSyncTokenDescription: Write-only device credential; it is never read back or logged.
deviceTodoSyncClearTokenDescription: Remove the stored server read token when applying these settings.
deviceTodoSyncIntervalDescription: Periodic HTTPS fallback polling, from 60 seconds to 24 hours.
deviceTodoSyncViewDescription: Choose which read-only snapshot the device displays.
deviceTodoSyncMqttBrokerDescription: Optional broker used only for update notifications; the snapshot is fetched over HTTPS.
deviceTodoSyncMqttTopicDescription: Optional topic for server update notifications.
deviceTodoSyncMqttUsernameDescription: Optional username for the TLS MQTT broker.
deviceTodoSyncMqttPasswordDescription: Write-only MQTT broker password; it is never read back.
deviceTodoSyncMqttClearPasswordDescripti: Remove the stored MQTT broker password when applying these settings.
deviceStatusReady: Configuration loaded. Passwords are never read back from the device.
deviceStatusTimeout: The device did not respond in time. Check configuration mode and try again.
deviceStatusBluetoothUnavailable: Bluetooth is unavailable in this environment.
deviceStatusSerialUnavailable: USB serial is unavailable in this environment.
deviceStatusSerialAccessDenied: The USB serial port is busy or unavailable. Close other serial monitors and try again.
deviceStatusWifiScanUnavailable: Wi-Fi scanning is unavailable; enter a hidden network manually.
deviceStatusApplyRejected: The device rejected these settings. Reconnect to load the latest configuration.
deviceStatusProtocolError: The device returned an unsupported or invalid response.
deviceStatusInvalidConfig: Check the required fields and idle sleep range.
deviceStatusSecureStorage: The device credential could not be protected with operating-system encryption.
deviceStatusLocalManagement: The device could not be reached over the local network.
deviceStatusError: Could not connect to or configure the device.
deviceGalleryDescription: Convert images to the panel's black, white, yellow, and red palette before sending them over the current Bluetooth, USB, or local-network connection.
deviceGalleryAddressDescription: Memorilo discovers this device automatically on your local network.
deviceGalleryCropHint: Drag to choose the visible area. Use arrow keys for precise adjustments.
deviceGalleryImagePreviewError: This image cannot be previewed. Choose another image.
deviceGalleryRenderError: The gallery preview failed. The rest of Settings is still available.
deviceGallerySlideshowDescription: Intervals are at least five minutes so the gallery never holds a permanent sleep blocker.
deviceGallerySlideshowRequiresMultiple: Add at least two images to enable slideshow mode.
deviceGalleryEmpty: No images are stored on the device.
deviceGalleryTokenRequired: Apply and securely store a local management token before loading the gallery.
deviceGalleryIdle: Load the gallery to view and manage images over the current device connection.
deviceGalleryUnavailable: Connect with Bluetooth or USB, or configure local device access.
deviceGalleryConverting: Resizing and converting to four colors…
deviceGallerySaving: Waiting for the device to commit the change…
deviceGalleryDeviceError: The device rejected the last gallery change. Review storage limits and try again.
deviceGalleryCapacityExceeded: The device is out of gallery storage. Delete an image and try again.
deviceGalleryStorageFailure: The device could not write its gallery storage. Check the assets partition and try again.
deviceGalleryAssetNotFound: The selected gallery image no longer exists on the device. Reload the gallery and try again.
deviceGalleryInvalidAssetLength: The image has an unsupported device size. Choose the image again and retry.
deviceGalleryInvalidAssetName: The image name is not accepted by the device. Choose the image again and retry.
deviceGalleryInvalidOrder: The gallery order is stale. Reload the gallery and try again.
deviceGalleryInvalidSlideshowInterval: The slideshow interval is not accepted by the device.
deviceGalleryError: Could not update the gallery over the selected connection. Check that the device is connected and try again.
deviceRemoteControlDescription: Read the device's LAN status or send a display/navigation command.
deviceRemoteStatusUnavailable: Apply settings to enable device controls.
deviceRemoteStatusError: The device could not be reached. Check Wi-Fi, address, and token.
calendarDescription: Manage Todo behavior and subscribed calendars.
calendarFeedAfterDaysDescription: Include events this many days after the request day.
calendarFeedBeforeDaysDescription: Include events this many days before the request day.
calendarFeedCompletedDescription: Choose whether completed Todos appear in the external ICS feed.
calendarFeedTimeZoneDescription: IANA timezone used when placing undated and timed Todos in the feed.
calendarFeedUndatedDescription: Choose whether Todos without a date appear on the request day.
calendarFeedOptionsNotice: Changing the Todo feed options changes this URL. Update the subscription in your calendar app.
calendarFeedNotConfigured: Create a private ICS feed to subscribe to Todos from another calendar app.
themeFluentDescription: Clear hierarchy with familiar desktop density.
themeNeubrutalismDescription: Bold strokes, flat surfaces, and direct contrast.
editorDescription: Adjust writing and pasted-content behavior in Memorilo.
shortcutsDescription: Customize keyboard shortcuts used throughout Memorilo.
learningDescription: Manage daily goals and card scheduling.
mcpDescription: Connect external AI tools to your local notes.
syncServerEnabledDescription: Connect this device to a Sync Server in addition to direct peer-to-peer sync.
syncServerUrlDescription: Use the ws:// or wss:// address exposed by the server.
syncServerPeerIdDescription: Peer identity from the server pairing invitation.
syncServerPairingInvitationDescription: Paste the invitation from the server web page to create this device's pairing response.
syncServerPairingResponseDescription: Paste this response into the server web page to authorize this device.
syncServerIssuedCredentialDescription: After completing pairing on the server web page, paste the issued credential here.
syncServerUrlRequired: Configure the Sync Server URL before pairing.
syncServerInvitationInvalid: The Sync Server invitation is invalid.
syncServerCredentialRequired: A server peer ID and issued device credential are required.
syncServerPairingResponseReady: Pairing response created. Complete pairing on the server web page, then paste the issued credential below.
syncServerPairingCompleted: Sync Server paired. Restart Memorilo to apply the server connection.
syncServerRestartNote: Restart Memorilo to activate the server connection.
syncServerInvitationPlaceholder: Paste invitation from server web page
syncServerCredentialPlaceholder: Paste credential from server web page
syncServerPairingInvitationHelp: Open the sync server management page in your browser and copy the invitation code.
syncServerPairingResponseHelp: Copy this response and paste it into the server management page.
syncServerIssuedCredentialHelp: After completing pairing on the server page, paste the credential here.
syncServerStatusDescription: Direct peer-to-peer sync remains available independently of the server.
syncServerRelayWarning: Relay mode stores no transferred data and cannot restore anything while your other devices are offline.
syncServerAuthoritativeDescription: Authoritative mode keeps plaintext server data. Clearing it does not delete local device data.
syncServerPolicyChanged: The Sync Server policy changed. The new modes are now active.
syncServerDataResetDetected: The Sync Server data was cleared. Local data remains on this device and will bootstrap the new server generation.
mediaDescription: Manage image conversion, stored assets, and database backups.
syncServerSectionDescription: Connect this device to a self-hosted or trusted Memorilo Sync Server, alongside direct peer-to-peer sync.
p2pDeviceNameDescription: Shown to nearby and paired devices. Changing it does not change this device's identity or keys.
p2pDiscoveryDescription: Temporarily let another Memorilo device on this network find and request to pair with this one.
p2pNoNearbyDevices: No discoverable Memorilo devices or pairing requests on this network.
p2pNoPairedDevices: No devices have been paired yet.
p2pConnectionSummary_one: {{count}} paired device is connected on the local network
p2pConnectionSummary_other: {{count}} paired devices are connected on the local network
p2pCompareEmoji: Compare these five emoji on both devices before confirming
p2pEmojiCheck: Compare the five emoji with the other device, then confirm.
p2pWaitingForConfirmation: Emoji confirmed. Waiting for the other device.
learningEnabledDescription: Enable flashcards, cloze authoring, FSRS scheduling, learning pages, and image occlusion.
todoEnabledDescription: Show the Todo workspace without changing Todo blocks inside the editor.
autoCompleteParentTasksDescription: Complete a parent Todo when all direct Todo children are complete, and reopen it when one is reopened.
blankTaskDurationMinutesDescription: Default duration for tasks created from an empty timeline slot.
timelineWorkdayStartMinutesDescription: First visible time in the Todo timeline.
timelineWorkdayEndMinutesDescription: Last visible time in the Todo timeline.
keepTodoDetailOpenDescription: Keep the selected task open when a change removes it from the current Todo view.
recurringTaskCompletionActionDescription: Choose where the completed occurrence and the next task are placed.
redrawTitlebarDescription: Place the application menus beside Memorilo. Turn off to use the system title bar. Takes effect after restarting the app.
cursorSettingsDescription: Tune cursor movement, blink, and particle feedback.
panelTabOrderDescription: Choose which tab appears first in the tray panel.
defaultNoteLearningEnabledDescription: Choose whether newly created Notes participate in Learning by default.
weekStartDescription: Choose the first day shown in calendars.
outdentBehaviorDescription: Choose how Shift-Tab moves selected blocks in Outline mode.
networkImagePasteBehaviorDescription: Download remote image links into managed assets when pasting, or keep their original URLs.
shortcutDescription: Press a key combination to replace the shortcut. Press Backspace to clear it.
readerArrowKeyPageTurningDescription: Use the left and right arrow keys to turn pages while reading.
readerAnnotationCopyFormatDescription: Choose what is included when copying highlighted text.
readerEpubPresentationModeDescription: Choose original book formatting or optimized reading layout for reflowable EPUB books.
readerPageModeDescription: Choose continuous vertical reading or one page at a time.
tiffConversionFormatDescription: Images in formats that cannot be displayed directly are converted to this browser-compatible format before being stored.
mcpEnabledDescription: Expose Memorilo through a local MCP server for external AI tools.
mcpAccessTokenDescription: Bearer token required by MCP clients. Keep it private.
assetsDescription: Find managed image files that are no longer referenced by any note.
assetsCouldNotMoveToTrash_one: {{count}} file could not be moved to Trash.
assetsCouldNotMoveToTrash_other: {{count}} files could not be moved to Trash.
assetsCouldNotDeletePermanently_one: {{count}} file could not be permanently deleted.
assetsCouldNotDeletePermanently_other: {{count}} files could not be permanently deleted.
flashcardsDescription: Control how cards enter and move through the learning queue.
goalsDescription: Set a sustainable target without hiding reviews that are still due.
newCardsPerDayDescription: Maximum number of never-practiced cards introduced during each study day. Set to 0 to introduce none.
dailyLimitDescription: Used only when the daily learning goal is set to a daily limit.
allDue: Review all due cards each day
p2pDescription: Sync directly between Memorilo devices on the same local network.
